name: TensorRT-LLM running-request gauge
notes: TensorRT-LLM main, MetricsCollector in tensorrt_llm/metrics/collector.py, read 2026-10-04. collector.py line 32 carries the header comment 'Adapted from https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/v0.10.0rc1/vllm/engine/metrics.py#L30', so this is a vLLM fork with the prefix swapped to trtllm_. NOT ON BY DEFAULT: the collector is only constructed and /prometheus/metrics only mounted when --return_perf-metrics is set (llm_args default False). Endpoint is :8000/prometheus/metrics - NOT /metrics, and the server's own GET /metrics serves a JSON iteration-stats snapshot, so a scraper pointed at /metrics gets JSON rather than exposition text. Labels are model_name and engine_type. Documented 'Number of active requests'. This is inflight-batching 'active' state, which the Triton backend separately reports as a label on nv_trt_llm_request_metrics{request_type="active"} - so the same quantity has two shapes depending on which server you run.
